name: Anbernic RG556

models.name: RG556
models.notes: Single model; black or translucent blue

summary: Anbernic's top-end Android handheld as of 2026-10: Unisoc T820 (6 nm) with 8 GB RAM, UFS 2.2 storage, active cooling (fan + heat pipe), and a 5.48-inch AMOLED panel at 1080×1920 with USB-C DisplayPort 1080p out. Running Android 13. GammaOS Next (a LineageOS-based Android build) publishes a T820 image; no Linux custom firmware exists for the T820 from community projects. Vendor publishes Android 13 builds via FOTA and System Update index.

specs.cpu: Unisoc T820, 6 nm: 1× Cortex-A76 @2.7 GHz + 3× Cortex-A76 @2.3 GHz + 4× Cortex-A55 @2.1 GHz
specs.storage: 128 GB UFS 2.2, TF up to 2 TB
specs.media: 5.48-inch AMOLED, OCA full fit, 1080×1920, USB-C DisplayPort 1080p out

variants.storage: 128 GB UFS 2.2, TF up to 2 TB
variants.notes: Single model available in black or translucent blue. UFS 2.2 and 8 GB RAM make it the fastest Anbernic Android device documented here. Active cooling with fan plus heat pipe. Hall joystick, Hall triggers, six-axis gyro, vibration motor, joystick light control. Battery claimed 8 hours, 5 V/2 A, ~3.5 h charge. DisplayPort over USB-C at 1080p — a vendor feature claim, not a desktop-mode guarantee.

homebrew.name: GammaOS Next
homebrew.firmware: Android 13/14 (LineageOS 20/21) image, Full or Lite; v1.2 for the RG556, flashed with UnisocTools/SPRD on Windows.
homebrew.summary: LineageOS-based Android replacement for Anbernic T820 handhelds. Fresh install only, flashed from Windows with UnisocTools after unlocking the bootloader; the device is wiped.

compatibility.note: GammaOS Next lists the Anbernic RG556 with its own v1.2 image. Its installation wiki groups the RG556 with the T820 devices and requires Windows: Unisoc USB drivers, the bootloader unlock script (which factory-resets the device), then the .pac image flashed with the SPRD/ResearchDownload tool.

requirements: A Windows PC: the wiki's RG556 path uses UnisocTools and ResearchDownload.exe.
Unisoc/Spreadtrum USB drivers (UnisocDrivers/DPInst64.exe in the release).
The GammaOS Next Patreon password while the release is still Patreon-locked (public after 60 days).
warnings: Unlocking the bootloader factory-resets the device, and installing GammaOS Next wipes it again.
Fresh install only; the wiki documents no upgrade path from the stock Anbernic Android build.
This is an Android replacement, not a Linux port for the T820.
